subheader: Simple, fast, and built for mini‑jobs in Germany.

steps.title: Post your job
steps.description: Describe the tasks, time and pay. We surface your job to relevant local helpers.

steps.title: Compare applicants
steps.description: Review ratings, badges, distance and response rate. Chat to align on details.

steps.title: Hire with confidence
steps.description: Confirm the booking and follow our mini‑job checklist (rates, registration, monthly cap).

fees-payment.title: Fees & payment
points: Posting a job is free. You only pay your helper directly according to the agreed rate.
Agree on hourly vs fixed price before the work starts. Keep a simple log of hours.
Cash or bank transfer are common for household mini‑jobs; keep receipts for your records.

trust-safety.title: Trust & safety
points: Check profiles for badges like ID and First Aid.
Use in‑app chat to clarify tasks, tools and expectations.
Share only what’s necessary and arrange a brief intro meeting if helpful.

checklist.title: Mini‑job checklist (Germany)
checklist.description: This is for information only and not legal advice
list: Ensure the hourly rate meets or exceeds the legal minimum wage.
If it’s a recurring household mini‑job, register via Haushaltsscheck when required.
Keep monthly earnings within the mini‑job threshold to maintain status.
Clarify liability/accident coverage as applicable for household work
